name: DY Patil University Online

about.text: In 2003, Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth, Pune (Deemed University) was established as a standalone institution for online education through the establishment of a Center for Online Learning (COL). Through this center, UGC recognized undergraduate and postgraduate programs are offered in a 100% online medium.

At DPU COL, students can obtain an Online BBA, an Online MBA, and other specialized diplomas such as Healthcare Management and Digital Marketing. The program faculty consists of University faculty combined with working professionals to bring both academic theory and real-world applications.

about.text: Course materials, live lectures, and recorded lectures are available on a Learning Management System (LMS), which is secure and mobile-friendly. All online assessments and exams are conducted through the UGC compliant LMS, utilizing live proctoring systems to maintain the integrity of the examination process.

The LMS also allows for non-supervised, self-paced learning opportunities through practice assessments, quizzes, discussion forums, and assignments (homework) in addition to progress tracking. This design engages and provides continuous opportunities for students to acquire knowledge and skills.

facts: The university has all the accreditations and recognitions for providing full-time online education: UGC-DEB as well as AICTE, NIRF (Rank 44 in University Category), ISO, AIU, ACU, WES and more.
Dr. D.Y. Patil University is a NAAC rated A++ institution with a grade point of 3.64.
DPU-COL has multifaceted learning support features such as an e-learning toolkit, self-evaluation kits, case studies, university LMS, digital libraries etc.

D.Y. Patil University has a separate placement cell dedicated only to the online division of learning, and partners with a large number of companies like American Express, HDFC Bank, Bajaj and many more.
The faculty of the university is very well-trained in delivering education through the online mode and is additionally highly qualified and experienced in their fields.
The university has a network of over one lakh experienced alumni across the globe.

emi.text: For getting financial assistance in paying the academic fee and other study expenses one can check out the easy financing options available in the market like education loans or easy-to-pay EMI installments. DY Patil University doesn’t provide these financing options. However, the College Vidya Portal assists the students in these financing options like education loan/EMI options.

admission.text: Admission process in the DY Patil University is in online mode. Admission sessions are conducted twice in a year that is in January and July month. No entrance exams are conducted to take admission in the DY Patil university. Admissions are done on direct-basis. The admission procedure 2023 for the online courses at DPU-COL is as follows:
Step 1- Go to the official website of DY Patil Online and click on “Admissions” and then fill in your basic details for mobile number and email verification.
Step 2- Fill in all your basic personal information followed by educational and professional information.
Step 3- Upload all the required documents along with your passport-size photo and signature.
Step 4- Pay the fee online and then submit the form.
Step 5- Once all the documents are verified, your admission confirmation will be sent to you via email or SMS along with your student login credentials.

faqs.q: Does D.Y. Patil University provide fully online degrees?
faqs.a: Yes, the Centre for Online Learning of Dr. D.Y. Patil University provides two full-time online degree courses- BBA and MBA.

faqs.q: Is an Online Degree from Dr. D.Y. Patil Valid?
faqs.a: Yes, being a university accredited by the UGC-DEB for providing online education, an online degree/diploma/certificate from D.Y. Patil University is indeed valid and credible in India as well as abroad.

faqs.q: Is there scholarship facility at DPU for its online course?
faqs.a: There are scholarship and fee concessions for certain special categories- students from a defence background or with special abilities and alumni of the university.

faqs.q: How are the exams conducted for the online courses at D Y Patil?
faqs.a: The university conducts online proctored exams at designated exam centres for the online courses.

faqs.q: What specialisations are there in online MBA of DPU?
faqs.a: The online MBA programme of D.Y. Patil University has 14 specialisations including marketing management, financial management, human resource management, IT management, project management and many more.
